name: Aurora Seven
about: Aurora Seven (1962 TAU 1), a crewed vehicle (Mercury MA), launched 1962 May 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1962 May 24), held fixed
